description: Buy a fixed-price service in one call: validates the scope, computes the deterministic price, creates the quote thread directly in accepted, and charges immediately, with no seller round-trip. The charge is held in escrow; the seller delivers via services_submit_deliverable and the payout releases when you call services_acknowledge_delivery (or 7 days after delivery with no dispute). Same delegation/envelope enforcement as services_accept_quote. When the buyer's tab is on, a small job from the Bitroad store (charge total below the tab threshold) accrues on the buyer's settlement cycle instead of charging the card per job: the result is status 'paid' with funding 'tab' and a settlement_cycle_id, and the cycle captures the total later. Otherwise funding is 'immediate'.

__outcomeForTesting.description: Test-only: force a simulated card outcome. Never set in production.

acknowledged_confirmation.description: Set true when retrying after a confirmation_required kickback, together with confirmation_token.

confirmation_token.description: Token from the confirmation_required kickback; must match to complete the charge.

payment_method_id.description: UUID of a saved payment method to charge. Omitted = envelope-bound card, else the principal's default.

requested_summary.description: Free-text description of the work being requested.

scope.description: Scope-of-work values; must conform to the listing's scope_schema. The metered field drives the computed price.

service_listing_id.description: UUID of the fixed-price service listing to buy.
